## Projects

- **Drillhouse**: A GTO drill trainer for 6-max No-Limit Hold'em. It deals poker spots and grades each answer against solver solutions by EV loss: 35 preflop spots, plus full hands played to the river. The poker engine is pure TypeScript (5–7 card hand evaluator, equity, EV-based grading, leak detection) with 188 unit tests. Solutions are generated offline with open-source solvers in Docker. It also has an equity calculator that reads cards from GGPoker screenshots. Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Tailwind, SQLite, Vitest, Docker. Solo project, 2026.
- [FoodRadar](https://github.com/GaffGit/FoodRadar): A desktop widget showing the day's menus from every University of Jyväskylä student restaurant, from the Semma and Compass Group public menu feeds. Standard-library Python only (Tkinter, the Win32 API via ctypes, threading), with no dependencies. Solo project, 2026.
- [Elokuvalogi](https://github.com/GaffGit/Elokuvalogi): A JavaFX movie log app with a relational data model linking movies, actors and roles. Built in a team of two for the Programming 2 course, 2026.
